author: Second Wind
description:
From arcade classics like Frogger, to ‘90s JRPG royalty like Chrono Trigger, to modern indie platformers like Big Hops, Marty is thoroughly convinced that frogs make for the absolute best animal-based video game characters.

Music used in order of appearance:
Curiosity – Frog Fractions OST
Main Menu – Big Hops OST
Thunder Harvest – Spiritfarer OST
Pearl's Shrine – Crypt Custodian OST
Firefly Swamp 1 – Frogger's Adventures: The Rescue OST
